fact: The RNU, set up in 2015, now holds 1,000,649 households in 2026 and is used to select PNBSF beneficiaries (383,227 households from the registry in 2026); updating, reliable identity of household heads and interoperability with other social systems are announced priorities.
title: Bourses familiales : le RNU compte 1 000 649 ménages après la recertification
